macros.name: ChemCite
macros.doc: The first time the \ChemCite macros appear in the latex document with a given key is where the consecutive number label for the key is defined (unless user-defined label are being used). • Using macros \ChemCite* provides the label without defining the consecutive number label.

macros.name: ChemMainCounterStyle
macros.doc: Converts the counter used for the main key label into a number or letter. The default implementation uses \arabic to generate a number.

macros.name: ChemShortLabelStyle
macros.doc: Formats the labels when they appear without the entity name.

macros.name: DefineChemical
macros.doc: You define the names and optional sub-label of a compound or entity using the \DefineChemical {⟨key⟩} {⟨name⟩} {⟨sub-label⟩} macro.

macros.name: NoCite
macros.doc: Search for the label and sublabel for a given key without producing any output.
